_comment: Authoritative IDTA Submodel-Template semanticId allowlist OpenDPP anchors to. The IRIs are EXTRACTED (never hand-typed) from the IDTA submodel-templates registry at the pinned commit below, recording each anchor's published/deprecated status + version. It mirrors the OpenDPP backend's machine-checked snapshot (anchors kept in lockstep); refreshed when the registry is re-pinned. Classify any AAS file's semanticIds against it with `node validate/validate.mjs semanticids <aas-file>`. This is IDENTITY (the semanticId is the genuine IDTA template id), NOT structural conformance to that template.
